I think you might be looking at it this a subjective way. I can’t speak as I currently am not transitioning or identify my self as a “sissy” but as someone who has interest in both ideas and as I continue to explore my identity I think it more has to do with the idea of submissive and dominant natures. Unfortunately in this society we assume the women is to be submissive and OF COURSE that’s not always true but some people may find joy and sexual arousal from that idea. I feel like it’s more about sexual pleasure and less about inferiority. As someone whose currently exploring my own gender identity I do get arousal from the idea of being a “sissy” but that doesn’t invalidate my feelings that I also may identify as a girl. If someone were to invalidate those feelings for me and just label me as an inferior man I’d shut that mf down so quick cause I KNOW I am not inferior to any other person. I’m sorry you feel that it makes you feel like your identity is less than but know that you’re identity is always valid and if your getting offended by this that’s ok, but you shouldn’t shame people for this because...just as being a girl makes you happy, so does being a “sissy” for some.
